resource_summary.note: Upper bounds use full scalar normal spaces as codomain before residual projection; residual/S3 projection reduces rows. Even so, dense floors for large (m,d) exceed 8 GB — sparse relative Fitting over the base ring is required for WP-L2.

gate: First dispatch — universal polar expansion through 3m+3
headline: OPEN

claims.claim: Universal equations U.3m+1 and U.3m+3 are written in normal jets on Z_t / P(N); they do not identify L_t^{src} with a subvariety of Z_t.
Source-line based/residual conditions constrain p_d(0,y) only; they enter the lifting tower as side conditions on the terminal coefficient, not as substitutes for L_r.
Odd-m leading a_m evaluates to a map into L_t^{tgt}; F-landing on the target is automatic at order 3m and constrained at 3m+1 via B(b_{m+1};a_m,a_m)=0.
Solutions of the lifting equations are formal jets, not certified covariants (house rule 3).

isolation_maps.indexing: r = 0,1,2,... indexes the normal-order correction p_{m+r}. The F-equation that first involves p_{m+r} as newest unknown (among even F-orders) defines L_r when that equation is linear in p_{m+r}.

next_even_F_orders.note: Not certified as a computed stage in this dispatch; the symbolic ledger extends by the same triple enumeration.

steps.L_0: 0  (no linear constraint from F at leading order)
steps.note: a_m is constrained only by residual D12 / global equalizer data from the linear strata machine, not by F at order 3m.
steps.omega_0: 0 in coker(0) — free leading jet subject to residual equivariance

steps.omega_1: omega_1 ∈ coker(L_1), where L_1: {E_+-valued jets of normal order m+1} → {scalar jets of normal order 3m+1}. Explicitly L_1 depends quadratically on a_m via B(-;a_m,a_m).

steps.F_order: no exclusive even F-order linear in a_{m+2} alone before 3m+3
steps.L_2: At F-order 3m+3, a_{m+2} appears only through 2 B(b_{m+1}; a_m, a_{m+2}), jointly with b_{m+3}. Treated as a free correction parameter at stage r=2, entering the residual of stage r=3.
steps.note: House rule: do not force a false linear isolation. a_{m+2} is a relative parameter for the r=3 Fitting problem.
steps.omega_2: 0 — no cokernel obstruction at a pure a_{m+2} stage

steps.omega_3: omega_3 = class of R_3 in coker(L_3). Vanishing of omega_3 is the relative obstruction to lifting through order 3m+3.

director_spine.covariant_parity: p_r is E_+-valued for even r and E_--valued for odd r; p|_{E_-}=p_d(0,y)

first_order_automatic.reason: Pure leading term a_m is E_--valued; F|_{E_-}=0 so Phi(a_m,a_m,a_m)=0. Moreover 3m is odd, so the order is also killed by y-evenness of F(p).

notation.p_minus: a_m + a_{m+2} + a_{m+4} + ...  (E_--valued, odd normal orders)
notation.p_plus: b_{m+1} + b_{m+3} + b_{m+5} + ...  (E_+-valued, even normal orders)

live_triples.term: 3 Phi(b_{m+1}, a_m, a_m) = B(b_{m+1}; a_m, a_m)

proof: Only triple of normal orders summing to 3m+1 with each ≥ m and not all odd is (m,m,m+1) up to permutation.
By definition B(z;y,y)=3 Phi(z,y,y), hence B(b_{m+1}; a_m, a_m)=0.
Triple-E_- contribution at (m,m,m) has order 3m (odd) and vanishes both by y-evenness of F(p) and by F|_{E_-}=0.

live_triples.term: 3 Phi(b_{m+3}, a_m, a_m) = B(b_{m+3}; a_m, a_m)

proof: Even F-order 3m+3; enumerate triples i+j+k=3m+3 with i,j,k≥m, excluding triple-E_-. Combinatorial list is independent of the value of odd m (translate indices by m).
Contribution (m,m+1,m+2): mult 6 → 2 B(b_{m+1}; a_m, a_{m+2}) because B(z;y1,y2)=3 Phi(z,y1,y2) and 6 Phi = 2·3 Phi.
Contribution (m+1,m+1,m+1): F(b_{m+1})=F_+(b_{m+1}) since b_{m+1} is E_+-valued.
No (1 odd + 2 even) triple sums to 3m+3 with min odd order m: m+(m+1)+(m+1)=3m+2 and m+(m+1)+(m+3)=3m+4.

order_ledger.valid_for: all odd positive integers m; all degrees d ≥ m

y_evenness_of_Fp.consequence: Only even normal orders in F(p) can give equations. Odd orders (including 3m, 3m+2, ...) vanish automatically.
y_evenness_of_Fp.reason: F is G-invariant and p is t-covariant, so F(p(t x))=F(t p(x))=F(p(x)); t(z+y)=z-y.

polarization.Phi_formula: Phi(u,v,w)=(1/3) sum_i (u_i v_i w_{i+1} + u_i w_i v_{i+1} + v_i w_i u_{i+1})
